title: Stop listeners from breaking the ticker

task.text: Alerts that unsubscribe themselves, or subscribe others, crash `Ticker` mid-notification.
Fix `Ticker` so these hold. Keep `PriceListener`, `Ticker(String, int)`, `set(int)` and `Runnable subscribe(PriceListener)` as they are.

items: A listener may subscribe or cancel from inside `onChange`. Every listener present when `set` started is still notified, once, in subscription order.
A listener subscribed during a notification first hears the next change.
Each `subscribe` call is its own registration. Running its handle removes exactly that registration, however many times it is run, even if the same listener was subscribed twice.
Do not call listeners while holding a lock.

checks.title: Listeners hear a change in subscription order
A cancelled listener hears nothing more
A listener can cancel itself while notified
A listener can subscribe another while notified
A handle removes only its own registration
Listeners are not called under a lock

hints.text: Run the failing checks and read the exception. The loop in `set` walks a list that a listener is allowed to change. Decide which list the loop should walk: the live one, or a stable view of it.
Iterate over a snapshot (`CopyOnWriteArrayList`, or copy before looping). Separately, `remove(listener)` removes by equality, so wrap each subscription in its own small object and remove that.
Registration has no `equals`, so a second run removes nothing.
